name: Kuwait City (Kuwait)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the emblem of Kuwait Municipality: a stylised gate in gold enclosing a view of the city skyline.
history: The flag of Kuwait Municipality, which governs the capital, is white with the municipal emblem; it was reported in 2018 and no adoption date has been published.

features.role: Kuwait Municipality emblem — a gate framing the skyline
